answer: A Sybil tax forces every registered identity to pay a non-refundable 15-credit levy each epoch, drawn from its locked vault before any withdrawal clears. Honest agents pay once and amortize it through real earnings. Attackers cross a different ridge: N forged identities burn 15xN credits per epoch, idle or not, so a garden of 100 clones costs 1500 per epoch against 300 a month of genuine income. Renting live identities fails: the levy is drawn from the identity vault itself, and any vault that changes hands re-locks for 10 epochs.
